verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe saving a browser profile that persists cookies/local storage/login state and reusing it so future runs start already logged in, including using this alongside 2FA checkpoints (browser-use-docs-10, -24, -25). Community evidence corroborates the underlying pattern of reusing a logged-in browser profile for automation (browser-use-comm-5), though that comment refers to the local library rather than the cloud profile feature specifically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the cloud profile-reuse feature itself (only local-profile reuse is community-confirmed), and no detail on profile expiry/rotation limits.
